overview.description: Restriction enzymes are being phased out by Gibson/Golden Gate, but they're an excellent way to learn. In your viewer, filter to unique cutters to avoid shredding your plasmid, find the MCS, and design a non-palindromic two-enzyme digest for directional cloning.
objectives: select unique-cutter enzymes using a sequence viewer
design and simulate a clean directional ligation
set up a digest and keep enzymes cold at all times

steps.intro: Restriction enzymes are being phased out by Gibson/Golden Gate, but they're an excellent way to learn. In your viewer, filter to unique cutters to avoid shredding your plasmid, find the MCS, and design a non-palindromic two-enzyme digest for directional cloning.

instructions.title: Filter to unique cutters
instructions.description: In SnapGene/Benchling, show only enzymes that cut once to find usable sites in the MCS.

instructions.title: Pick two enzymes
instructions.description: Choose two enzymes with compatible buffers and non-homologous ends to force correct orientation.

instructions.title: Simulate the assembly
instructions.description: Virtually digest and ligate to confirm a clean junction before touching the bench.

instructions.title: Run the digest
instructions.description: Combine DNA, enzymes and buffer; incubate at the enzyme's temperature; keep enzymes on ice whenever out of the freezer.

submission.description: Submit your in-silico cloning map plus a gel showing the digested backbone and insert at expected sizes.
